name: Hypewave: HandSync
summary:
Play custom songs using a controller or just your hands. Tackle challenges ranging from Easy to Normal and Hard, and achieve the highest score you can in this rhythm game. Choose from the available songs, build up the hype to stay in the game, and aim for a 5-star bonus.

Hypewave: HandSync is a VR rhythm game. You can play tour songs and our playlist music. Take a moment and have fun.
